reading: holding the measured real distance ratio fixed and setting the 2D noise to the measured reference-3D/2D residual reproduces the scale of the real-data focal error and flat rate. The real failure is therefore NOT weak perspective alone: it is a moderately weak-perspective geometry combined with a reference-3D/2D disagreement of several pixels. Either ingredient on its own is not sufficient.
caveat: this is an order-of-magnitude correspondence, not a fit. The synthetic noise is isotropic Gaussian on the 2D, whereas the real residual also carries correlated reconstruction error.
